title: Service Report Number format at maximum length
description: Ensure that the SR number format does not exceed the maximum length of 18 characters.
steps_summary: Sign in as any authorized role.
Navigate to the System Settings and configure the SR number format to include prefix, date, sequence, and suffix.
Ensure the total length is exactly 18 characters.
expected_result: The SR number is generated successfully with exactly 18 characters.

title: Service Report Number format exceeds maximum length
description: Ensure that the system prevents SR number formats that exceed 18 characters.

expected_result: The system blocks saving the configuration and displays an error message.

Select a Ticket from the dropdown.
Observe the Organization and Organization User fields.
expected_result: The Organization and Organization User fields are auto-populated and become read-only.

title: Clearing Ticket resets Organization and User

steps_summary: Sign in as any authorized role.
Navigate to the Create Service Report form.
Select a Ticket from the dropdown.
Observe the Organization and Organization User fields.
expected_result: The Organization and Organization User fields are cleared and become editable again.

title: Verify Service Report Type dropdown is visible and interactable

Locate the Service Report Type dropdown.
expected_result: The Service Report Type dropdown is visible and interactable.

title: Verify Internal Only toggle is visible and interactable

Navigate to the Create Service Report form.
expected_result: The Internal Only toggle is visible and interactable.

title: Whitespace-only input in required fields

Enter whitespace-only input in the Service Report Name field.
expected_result: The form submission fails with a validation error indicating that the input is invalid.

title: Special characters and SQL injection in text fields

title: Validate Service Report Name Length
description: Ensure that the service report name does not exceed 256 characters.
preconditions: User is logged in as an agent.
User has permission to create a service report.
steps_summary: Navigate to the Create Report form.
Enter a name for the service report that exceeds 256 characters.
expected_result: An error message should be displayed on the 'name' field stating: 'Service Report name cannot exceed 256 characters.'

inputs.name: A very long service report name that exceeds the maximum allowed length of 256 characters. This name is intentionally made long to test the validation logic in the form. It should trigger an error message indicating that the name cannot exceed the specified character limit. This is a crucial test to ensure that the system handles input validation correctly and prevents excessively long names from being submitted, which could cause issues in the database or user interface.

title: Access Check for Report Form Options
description: Verify that only users with appropriate access can fetch report form options for a given ticket.
preconditions: User is logged in as an agent.
User has a staff ID and department access.
steps_summary: Attempt to fetch report form options for a ticket without having access to the ticket's department.
expected_result: A 'FORBIDDEN' error message should be displayed, indicating the user does not have permission to access the ticket.
